dialogue_text: How much longer? About 20 minutes. The rain's holding up traffic.
The rain's holding up traffic. And my father? He's already arrived. I'm in for another lecture.
I'm in for another lecture. Oh, could you do me a favor? Kang Haesol. He's Chan's housekeeper. Look into him for me.
May I ask why? Did I sound like I was asking? I'm sorry, sir.
Truth, Lies, and...
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Sorry to keep you waiting. The traffic was terrible. Sit down. I've only seen you in photos. You're much better-lookingthan your father.
Thank you. You're too kind. You run a gallery now? Yes. Luce— I thought it was a passing fancy.Now he wants to stay for good.

I thought it was a passing fancy.Now he wants to stay for good. He's my son, but he's still immature. Young people have so much they want to do. It's time he learned what matters. Does he think he'll be young forever?
Does he think he'll be young forever? Oh, Representative Jung... Oh, about that bill. I spoke to Representative Min. The suggestion wasto delay implementation.
The suggestion wasto delay implementation. We can work out the timing. Let's meet again beforeit goes to committee.
Keep next weekend free. Next week— Still keeping that painter around?
I'll rearrange my schedule. How long will you clean up after him? Not "that guy."
Not "that guy." His name is Heo Chan. I never should've put him in your hands. After the exhibition,wrap it up and get ready.
After the exhibition,wrap it up and get ready. Father. Don't make me say it twice.
Shall I change next week's plans? I suppose so. He won't let this one go. Understood.
I'm so glad you could come in today. Call me anytime you need a hand. Can you come back to work? Yes, if there's an opening. All right. I'll call you soon.
All right. I'll call you soon.
Haesol! Take this table, please! Coming! The information you requested.
I also included news reportsabout his father's case.
Yes. Thank you. You can go. Yes, sir.
Painter Heo Chan suspends his careeramid allegations of murder involvement
[Publisher's editor]
Hello. How have you been, Mr. Seo? I'm well. How about you? Very well. I was calling about your next book...
I was calling about your next book... I was wondering how it's coming along. My next book...? Well, nothing's really come to me yet. No subjects have caught your interest?
No subjects have caught your interest? Nothing I could make a story out of yet. People keep asking lately. When will Seo Hajin's next book come out?
When will Seo Hajin's next book come out? I have been away for quite a while. I'm not trying to rush you... I know. It's just my guilty conscience. You're not still dwellingon what happened, are you?
You're not still dwellingon what happened, are you? Don't let it weigh on you. You know it wasn't your fault.
...You think so? I'll call when I have something. All right. Once you have a direction,please let me know first. Of course.
Of course.
Chan. Time to get up. Why are you here?
Why are you here? What do you mean, why? Did you look into what I asked?
Why haven't you put ointment on it? Sit up. I'll put some on for you.
Did you look into it?
He took time off school to pay his mother's bills.She's at Seorin General Hospital.

He took time off school to pay his mother's bills.She's at Seorin General Hospital. Her surgery's on hold becauseher bills haven't been paid. His father apparently killed himselfwhile a suspect in a murder case.
His father apparently killed himselfwhile a suspect in a murder case. A suspect?
How's the painting coming along? Would you stop rushing me?
Would you stop rushing me? It hurts when you put it like that.
...Hyung. I know what you meant. After all our years together,would I get upset over that?
After all our years together,would I get upset over that? I brought porridge. Eat some. I just stopped by.I have to get back to the gallery.
They called about your missed sessions. Next Monday, 2 p.m.I booked it. Make sure you go.
So if that's whyyou're lashing out at me, I understand how you feel. It must be painful.
I'd feel the same way.
He's quite something. Hello. About paying the medical bills...
About paying the medical bills... One moment, Mr. Kang. No, that's not what I meant... Could I put off the payment...? Oh? The interim bill has been paid.
Oh? The interim bill has been paid. What? The payment came in today. But I haven't paid it yet... I've checked again.Someone paid it on your behalf.
I've checked again.Someone paid it on your behalf. What do you mean...?
Does anything hurt? You don't have to keep coming.I know you're busy.
You don't have to keep coming.I know you're busy. Can't a son come see his mom? Want me to ask for more painkillers?
Want me to ask for more painkillers? Haesol... I'm not in pain anymore. I don't think I need surgery. What are you talking about? I was just overdoing it.
I was just overdoing it. A little rest, and I'm fine now. Let's go home now. Didn't you hear the doctor? Without surgery,you might never walk again!
Without surgery,you might never walk again! I said I'm fine. The hospital's just tryingto squeeze money out of us. I know my own body best. I'm getting discharged. That's final.
I'll arrange the surgery soon. How did you come up with all that money?
How did you come up with all that money? You're not doing anything shady, are you? It's nothing like that. Someone helped me, that's all. Who? Did you call your father's older brother?
Did you call your father's older brother? No. I got an advance on my wages. Don't worry. Haesol... This is hard on you,isn't it? Because of me...
Haesol... This is hard on you,isn't it? Because of me... Don't say that. I'm really okay. Your dad said the same thing. Whenever I asked, he'd say he was fine.
Whenever I asked, he'd say he was fine. I knew he was struggling, too. We were barely making ends meet. And I had to deal with peoplecoming to the shop to make a scene.
And I had to deal with peoplecoming to the shop to make a scene. I was struggling so much, too. Even though I knew howsensitive your dad was... I turned away to save myself.
I turned away to save myself. I should've stayed by his side. I should've told him,"I'm on your side, no matter what."
I should've told him,"I'm on your side, no matter what." It's not your fault, Mom. If I'd held his hand even once... Would your dad still be with us?
